description: Weekly update PR for the homelab compose images, run by .github/workflows/renovate.yaml (its cron is the schedule — no `schedule` here, so a manual dispatch also opens PRs). flake.lock is bumped by lockFileMaintenance (`nix flake update`, the same thing the retired update-flake-lock workflow did) in its own PR; each input follows the branch named in its `ref`, so release branches are never crossed. Merging does not deploy — run `just deploy` afterwards.

nix.description: The nix manager is beta and ships enabled: false; listing it in enabledManagers is not enough (first run on 2026-09-28 extracted only docker-compose).

lockFileMaintenance.description: Every flake input here tracks a branch, not a pinned rev, and Renovate only opens per-input PRs for rev-pinned inputs (second run on 2026-09-28: 'no results that look like a version', no PR). Branch-tracking inputs are refreshed by running `nix flake update` under lockFileMaintenance. 'at any time' so a manual dispatch also runs it; the workflow cron is the real schedule.

packageRules.description: One PR per week for everything non-major, so there is a single item to review.
Major versions can carry migrations for stateful services; wait until ticked on the Dependency Dashboard.
linuxserver tags are v<app>-ls<build>; treat the ls build number as part of the version.
